deployments_detail.use: Aarnibot, a generative AI companion giving field forest experts instant AI-driven answers to maximize productivity
UPM Pulp integrates AI across forest operations, mill operations and customer service for decision-making and safety

Aarnibot, a generative AI companion/mobile assistant for field forest experts giving instant AI-driven answers on silvicultural operations, applying regulations, execution guidance and information-system use (multimodal mobile interface for laptop-unfriendly forest environments). [Developed in-house by UPM]
AI-driven machine vision systems in pulp mills evaluating pulp bale quality, monitoring batch printing and wrapping, and tracking unit dimensions. [not disclosed]
AI chatbot used by mill engineers to analyze production/process issues, with plans to extend into fuller production assistants. [not disclosed]
AI-driven predictive/maintenance optimization: dashboards analyzing vibration, sound, temperature and load data to predict equipment failures before they happen. [not disclosed]
AI/machine vision for worker safety in pulp operations: accurately positioning lifting wires and identifying knot issues to enable safe handling of heavy pulp units. [not disclosed]
AI video-monitoring system for wood/log truck drivers to detect fatigue and distraction and prevent transport accidents (pilot phase). [not disclosed]
"Griffy" corporate AI chatbot to improve internal information access for employees, part of UPM's company-wide AI program. [not disclosed]

Customer-service AI models consolidating transactional data (orders, deliveries, invoicing, sustainability) to give customers instant answers and faster case resolution (early/testing stage). [not disclosed]
AI-powered automation of order intake (automated order processing) as one of twelve high-impact AI transformations. [not disclosed]
AI-powered invoice handling / automated document processing. [not disclosed]
AI-streamlined supplier query processes (automated handling of vendor/supplier interactions). [not disclosed]
